dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.createFirstProjectDesc: Projects live inside an organization. If you don't have one yet, you'll create it on the next step.

landing.heroSubtitle: Understand why your project exists. Track decisions, sources, and context alongside your tasks.
landing.featuresTitle: Everything a project needs to explain itself
landing.featuresSubtitle: Tasks alone don't tell you why a project looks the way it does. Guidon tracks the context around the work, not just the work.

taskBoard.title: Task Board
taskBoard.description: A Kanban board for every project, with columns you control. Rename, reorder, or hide statuses to match how your team actually works.

aiTaskApi.title: AI Task API
aiTaskApi.description: Let AI agents pick up tasks and move them through the same board your team uses, from in-progress to done, without a human relaying updates by hand.
bullets: Agents claim and complete tasks via API
Full audit trail of AI-driven changes
Human review built into the workflow

decisions.title: Decisions
decisions.description: A running log of the architectural and technical decisions your team makes, with the reasoning attached, so the "why" survives past the meeting it was made in.
bullets: Linked to the tasks and context they affect

knowledgeBase.title: Knowledge Base
knowledgeBase.description: Centralize the sources, docs, and technologies each project depends on, instead of scattering them across chats and wikis nobody checks.
bullets: One place new teammates can start

memoryContext.title: Memory & Context Graph
memoryContext.description: Guidon remembers project knowledge over time and connects decisions, sources, and tasks to each other, so context isn't lost as a project grows.
bullets: AI-generated insights you verify before they count as fact
A graph of relations between entities

roadmap.title: Roadmap
roadmap.description: Plan in phases and see where a project stands at a glance, without losing the day-to-day detail the task board already tracks.
bullets: Status at a glance across a project's lifetime
Stays connected to the tasks underneath it
